calls.video_title: Why Is SoundhoundAI Stock Crashing, and is it a Buying Opportunity? | SOUN Stock Analysis
calls.thesis: First tracked call: reiterates his long-standing avoid — down ~65% YTD and near 52-week lows, but his DCF fair value is only $2.02 vs $3.50, so still overvalued; not a buying opportunity yet.
calls.base_case: Revenue growth is mostly acquisition-led, not organic; 2026 outlook revised lower as management shifts to profitable recurring revenue.
calls.bull_case: Balance sheet is strong ($207m cash, almost no debt) and valuation is far cheaper than the peak (forward P/S 4.5 vs peak P/E 55); adjusted EBITDA positive guided for H2 2027.
calls.bear_case: Operating margin still -98% and cash flow from operations to sales -53%; profitability remains a long way off.
